pages.text: They filled a big wooden tub with grapes. Stomp them, and purple juice came out.
Lulu washed both feet and stood before the tub. "I want to get in and stomp too."
Uncle Beppo sat on the edge. "Foot rhythm is important. In our day, we used this song."
He sang a very, very slow old song. "Mmmm—ohhh, graaapes..."
The feet moved just as slowly. Press... press... Listening, the cousins nodded off.
Uncle Beppo's eyes closed to his own song. Wobble! Splash! He sat in the juice pooled beside the tub.
He looked at his purple bottom. "Ahem."
Lulu held the cousins' hands and climbed in. "Let us use a fast song! La-la-la!"
Hop, hop! Splash, splash! Juice poured out.
Everyone had purple feet. Uncle Beppo had purple feet and a purple bottom—the most purple of all!
